title: breaks/1: the cut points a styled layer bins against, with where they came from
description: One file per layer and measure, written by scripts/export-breaks.mjs and checked by lib/breaks/breaks.test.ts with the subset evaluator in data/schema/validate.mjs. A value's bin is the number of breaks it is at or above (lib/civic/places.ts binOf). Two rules JSON Schema cannot say are tested beside it: breaks rise strictly, and source carries exactly one of sha256 (one fetched body) and pages (a paginated source, each page's sha256).

layer.description: The layer or collection id: health (CDC PLACES counties) or a place export's collection id.

measure.description: CDC's measure id, or the export's feature name.

period.description: The data year or vintage the values describe, as the publisher gives it.

valueType.description: What a value is, including age-adjusted or crude where the publisher says.

rule.description: The exact formula, so a recomputation matches.

n.description: Units of the universe with a value: the count the breaks were cut from.

nNull.description: Units of the universe with no value. They take no bin.

universe.description: What the n units are. The legend prints it with n.

lastModified.description: The publisher's own last-modified stamp for what was fetched; null when it gave none.

sha256.description: sha256 of the one body fetched from url.

input.description: The committed file the breaks were computed from, relative to apps/map, and its sha256.
